title: A Leakage-Controlled Cold-Start Benchmark for Drug-Combination Synergy Classification
description: Reproducible code and results for a leakage-controlled benchmark of drug-combination synergy classification from pre-treatment identity and context descriptors on DrugComb v1.5, evaluated under standard and cold-start (leave-drug-out, leave-cell-line-out, leave-tissue-out, leave-study-out) regimes.
